value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for a community nonprofit's monthly program impact report agent kit
value.lets_workers: Turn a month of program records, such as sessions held, people served and outcome check-ins, into a results table that compares each measure with its target and with last month, and draft the monthly impact report with every figure traced to that table. The program manager checks every figure, and the executive director approves the report and shares it.
human_only: Check every figure against the program records.
Approve the report and how shortfalls are explained.
Share the report with the board and partners.
rules: Use only made-up, clearly marked test data. Never put a real person's details into the kit, a test case or an output.
Steps marked for a person stay with people. The agent drafts or helps; it never decides about a person and never contacts anyone.
Tools are read-only. Anything that changes records outside the requester's scope is a person's step.

provenance_notes.note: The marketplace's example of this kit. It holds only the catalog's own fields and points at this pack's kit and need nouns by value digest, so the kit has one source.

One recorded example run of the kit on a desktop computer with made-up data: check, build and independent review with the marketplace's own pipeline, zero model calls. Not a hosted run or an evaluation.

value.title: Monthly Program Impact Report Kit
value.category_reason: The agent's whole setup as one noun: its step map and pins to every part.
value.summary: Turns a month of program records into an impact report: totals by measure, change from last month, results against targets, and missing numbers kept as unknown. The program manager checks every figure, and the executive director approves the report and shares it.
value.goal: Help a community nonprofit turn a month of program records into an impact report that compares results with the month's targets and with last month, keeps every missing number visible and quotes no participant without approval, while the program manager checks the figures and the executive director approves and shares the report.
value.target_org: Community nonprofit reporting monthly results to its board and partners

step_map.title: Total the month's program records by measure
step_map.guidance: Total sessions, people served and outcome check-ins for the month by measure, compare each with the month's target and with last month, and keep any missing count as unknown, never zero.

step_map.title: Draft the monthly impact report
step_map.guidance: Draft the report's sections: highlights, results against targets, changes from last month, what staff are watching, and next month. Every number comes from the results table, and no participant is quoted without staff approval.

step_map.title: Check every figure against the program records
step_map.guidance: The program manager traces each figure to the program's own records and corrects or removes any figure that cannot be traced.

step_map.title: Approve the report and how shortfalls are explained
step_map.guidance: The executive director decides how shortfalls and changes are explained and approves the report.

step_map.title: Share the report with the board and partners
step_map.guidance: The executive director shares the approved report with the board and partners. The agent never sends or publishes the report.

value.title: Skill: draft a monthly impact report from a results table
value.name: impact-report-drafter
value.description: Drafts a monthly impact report from a results table, keeping every number traced to a measure and every gap visible.
value.instructions: Use the outline's sections and word limits: highlights, results against targets, changes from last month, what staff are watching, and next month. Take every number from the results table and cite its measure. Write missing numbers as not yet counted, and name the site they are missing from. Describe what was done and counted in plain words at an eighth-grade reading level, and never claim an outcome the records do not show. Use a participant quote only when staff have marked it approved, never with a name or a detail that could identify the person. Flag every measure below 90 percent of its target for the executive director's explanation.
refuses: Inventing or estimating a missing number
Claiming outcomes the records do not show
Quoting a participant without staff approval
Sharing the report outside the organization
